svg.title: SimPaths UK model structure — October 2026 development implementation
svg.desc: Conceptual annual module cycle. Charcoal process outlines indicate implementation in the checked UK development branch. Amber identifies alignment, external assumptions and costs: migration through population alignment, external wage-growth assumptions, and formal childcare costs. Purple dashed outlines indicate proposed extensions not implemented: home production, inter-vivos transfers and pension-rule imputation. Wealth and bequest processes are implemented. Circles group processes; arrows do not specify the exact execution schedule.
